x: Birnie, finished second and third in the senior hundred; whilst a very old friend in Charlie Cook annexed the Veterans' hundred yards.

All the heats in the 100 yards handicap, open to members of the three competing clubs, were won by Belgrave men; Gratte, the young runner who had a double win at our last meeting, again proved the winner on this occasion, with Birnie and Hughes, another young runner of promise, filling the other places.
